PHYSICS × ENGINEERING × PEOPLEGet to know me ↓
HELLO, I’M THANH

Good energy.
An open heart.

I'm Pham Tri Thanh, an athlete, music lover, and lifelong learner born in 2009, shaped by an unstoppable drive and a warm, open heart. I believe that energy and empathy are meant to be shared whether through the rhythm of a song, the grit of a game, or the ease of an honest conversation. Every new challenge I take on is a chance to bring good energy to the people around me.

My love for trying new things has taught me something simple yet powerful: you go fast when you go determined, but you go far when you go with kindness and great teammates. For me, sports, music, and communication are more than just passions they are the bridge between who I am today and the uplifting mark I want to leave on the world.

Always
curious! ✧
01 / THANH’S JOURNEY

Where my
curiosity began.

My love for STEM began with childhood LEGO bricks and a supportive mom who gave me opportunities to explore. What started with coding classes and early prototypes grew into a deeper interest in physics and the way things work.

Today, I want to turn that understanding into useful machines and meaningful work with my community.

Follow my journey↗

DEVELOPER / THERMAL ENERGY STORAGE

Storing heat

Our team explored how sand can retain heat from thermal and solar energy, with the needs of families in remote highland communities in mind.

03 / LEADERSHIP & COMMUNITY SERVICE

Community

Building a playground, renovating a library, teaching a first computer class: my community work brings me back to the people behind the problems I want to solve.

Through STEMese and Light of Book, I work with teammates to share practical knowledge and help children find more opportunities to learn.
